limits: Same precision/store/ports and fixed SFU step; shared vs dedicated is explicitly different multiplication area, never same arithmetic inventory.
One whole common store82 wrapper blackboxed from logic area. SRAM timing/area/power and layout/STA/PPA not qualified.
Counter and response/line buffer costs included in mapped logic; no free extra A SRAM, port, DMA lane, crossbar or full16x16 matrix array.
M/N serialized: normal workload has zero simultaneous clients. Separate arbitration stress qualifies finite protocol only; cannot promise zero delay under overlapping streams.
5beat serialized physical protocol is prototype, not real DRAM/native-model throughput. Repack/gather/DMA software overhead outside measured core cycles.
Cache fills every command and all8 experts A8 proven row-reused. Full16KiB occupied, no context/preload scratch; H2560 or additional contexts cannot inherit fit.
Earlier router/SiLU/encoding and model-quality failures remain external. This is unchanged integer cut, not application quality or general V/ROM integration.
